archive: CLEAR-SRAG SEP Benchmark Dataset v2.0; operational integral fluxes as-is from NOAA archives
downloadMethod: HTTP byte-range search by UTC date; original CSV header and requested date subset retained without changing flux strings
qualityTreatment: Blank, negative and non-finite flux values become null; zero preserved. No interpolation or cross-calibration. Source time-series product does not supply per-record spacecraft or quality flags.
sourcePrimaryNote: RT primary GOES-R+ series. The archived time-series CSV identifies primary selection, but does not retain a per-row spacecraft field. Do not assert a particular spacecraft for each row without separate instrument history.
